title: Evgeny Sokolov
summary: Evgeny Sokolov, born on 11 June 1984, is a professional road bicycle racer from Russia, known for his participation in competitive cycling events, including his tenure with the UCI ProTour team Bbox Bouygues Telecom.

sections.heading: Early Life and Background
paragraphs: Evgeny Sokolov was born in Russia on 11 June 1984. His early life and initial involvement in cycling are not extensively documented.

sections.heading: Professional Career
paragraphs: Sokolov is recognized for his achievements in road bicycle racing, having competed at a professional level.
He was last associated with the UCI ProTour team Bbox Bouygues Telecom, contributing to the team's efforts in various cycling competitions.

sections.heading: Connection to Ukraine
paragraphs: While Evgeny Sokolov is primarily identified as a Russian cyclist, the broader context of cycling in [[eastern-europe|Eastern Europe]], including [[ukraine|Ukraine]], highlights the regional significance of such athletes in promoting the sport across national boundaries.
